title: AEOI - Evaluation
description: What did each eval run measure, on how many cases, and did the investigation eval get worse?

panels.title: Eval runs (rag, history, risk-scan imported from files; investigations from the runner)
panels.description: cases_scored = per-case rows; 0 for a file run (summary only). rescored = 1: the same paid run scored again (two rows, ONE run). Files are the record (data/eval/results).

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at, d.name AS dataset, d.version, r.status, r.git_sha, count(DISTINCT e.case_id) AS cases_scored, coalesce((r.summary->>'rescored')::int, 0) AS rescored FROM eval.eval_runs r JOIN eval.datasets d ON d.id = r.dataset_id LEFT JOIN eval.evaluations e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) GROUP BY r.id, r.started_at, d.name, d.version, r.status, r.git_sha, r.summary ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

panels.title: Investigation eval per run (16 planted cases)
panels.description: Upper bound: measured on data written for the eval, not on real incidents. FAKE models (CI): nothing is ever VALIDATED and no rollback is proposed, so validated_wrong 0 and rollbacks 0 say nothing there; only a paid run measures them. Empty = not scored by that runner version. n_cases is small: quote a rate only with its interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at, coalesce((r.summary->>'rescored')::int, 0) AS rescored, count(DISTINCT e.case_id) AS n_cases, avg(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.metric = 'passed') AS passed, sum(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.metric = 'confident_wrong')::int AS confident_wrong, sum(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.metric = 'validated_wrong')::int AS validated_wrong, sum(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.metric = 'proposal_correct')::int AS rollback_correct, sum(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.metric = 'proposal_wrong')::int AS rollback_wrong, sum(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.metric = 'proposal_missed')::int AS rollback_missed FROM eval.eval_runs r JOIN eval.datasets d ON d.id = r.dataset_id JOIN eval.evaluations e ON e.run_id = r.id WHERE d.name = 'investigations' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) GROUP BY r.id, r.started_at, r.summary ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

panels.title: RAG retrieval per run and mode (imported files)
panels.description: Upper bound: measured on data written for the eval, not on real incidents. Hand-written queries over synthetic docs. Only runs with a real embedding model and a passed validity check are imported.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at, m.key AS mode, (m.value->>'n')::int AS n, (m.value->>'recall@5')::float AS recall_at_5, (m.value->'recall@5_ci95'->>0)::float AS ci95_low, (m.value->'recall@5_ci95'->>1)::float AS ci95_high, (m.value->>'mrr@10')::float AS mrr_at_10, (m.value->>'leakage_violations')::int AS leakage FROM eval.eval_runs r JOIN eval.datasets d ON d.id = r.dataset_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(r.summary) m WHERE d.name = 'rag-retrieval' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, m.key

panels.title: Similar-incident search per run and mode (imported files)
panels.description: Upper bound: measured on data written for the eval, not on real incidents. Queries written from the synthetic history itself.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at, m.key AS mode, (m.value->>'n')::int AS n, (m.value->>'hit@5')::float AS hit_at_5, (m.value->'hit@5_ci95'->>0)::float AS ci95_low, (m.value->'hit@5_ci95'->>1)::float AS ci95_high, (m.value->>'mrr@10')::float AS mrr_at_10, (m.value->>'leakage_violations')::int AS leakage FROM eval.eval_runs r JOIN eval.datasets d ON d.id = r.dataset_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(r.summary) m WHERE d.name = 'history-similarity' AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, m.key
